objective: Recover exact compiled method identities and conservatively associate their reported observations with canonical source methods for equal-access navigation.
population: All16 frozen source cases remain eligible. All compiled methods in each qualified retained r7 runtime case are accounted, including generated, missing-debug, XML-omitted and unmatched records. Closure runtime remains unavailable, never dropped.
identity: Pinned compiled SHA256/JaCoCo CRC, class binary name, source filename, access flags, full method descriptor and Code/LineNumberTable. Parse bytes only; do not load classes, compile or execute subjects.
source_association: Unique named-class chain plus method name, parameter count and containment of EVERY debug line in one complete canonical source declaration. Descriptor is exact compiled identity, not type-attributed Java syntax. Generated/bridge/initializer, absent-debug and ambiguous matches explicitly unresolved. Constructor prefixes and local/anonymous class naming are not guessed.
runtime: Exact retained XML method name/descriptor and instruction/method counters. Positive observations must bind qualified retained class/probe/source evidence. Scope remains original test-command phase including Ant/child JVMs, not test-exclusive causality. Zero or missing observations do not prove irrelevance.
qualification: Synthetic binary/descriptor/truncation/line/ambiguity tests before full16 census; pin every input and code before construction, exclusive durable receipts, no replay. This census measures availability, not accuracy and does not relax any previous quality gate.
open_questions: What fraction of retained reported method observations have unique source-coordinate associations, and what categories remain unresolved?
Does a future typed signature binder change ambiguous cases without inventing matches?
Which strong equal-access navigation policy, objective and population provide quality headroom before disjoint confirmation?
